every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use the exact same camera choreography across frames 1 to 9, keeping the 3D machinery in the right two-thirds of the viewport while the left card updates cleanly.

explains_the_project.reason: While both share the same helpful assembly-line metaphor in frames 1 to 9, the lighter floor and ambient fill in the second site make dark mechanical details like the storage drawers in frame 5 and the seven lanes in frame 8 easier to see and understand.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Across frames 1 to 9, the second site's lighter slate floor plane makes cast contact shadows clearly visible beneath the press, cabinet, and manifold, grounding the dark metal machinery much better than the near-black floor of the first site.

type_and_layout.reason: Frames 1 to 9 feature identical typography, card hierarchy, and left-aligned layout on both sites, leaving generous space for the 3D scene.

overall.reason: Although both sites share the same layout and 3D assembly-line concept, the second site's brighter slate floor and improved lighting reveal contact shadows and dark mechanical details that get lost against the pitch-black floor of the first site.
